name: Adult Acquired Flatfoot / Flexible Pes Planovalgus
tags: adult acquired flatfoot / flexible pes planovalgus
definition: Flattening of the medial longitudinal arch with hindfoot valgus in adults, caused by structural, tendon or ligament dysfunction and varying from flexible to rigid deformity.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing foot/ankle radiographs characterize alignment; MRI is selective.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Rigid or progressive symptomatic deformity may require surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-vikriti phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Flattening of the medial longitudinal arch with hindfoot valgus in adults, caused by structural, tendon or ligament dysfunction and varying from flexible to rigid deformity.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
